title: Roadmap Interlock Concierge & Conflict Resolver
creator: Lena Nguyen
description: Build a lightweight "concierge" layer on top of our existing dependency registry that surfaces imminent handoffs, proactively detects conflicts across Eng/Design/Security/Infra, and provides a guided conflict-resolution workflow for PMs and engineering leads. Goal is to reduce last-minute cutover fights, improve visibility into readiness signals, and automate low-friction escalations to the appropriate owners.
background: Current dependency trackers require manual triage during roadmap alignment. Teams often spot conflicts only during the final two weeks of a cycle, leading to rework and missed SLAs for Dedicated/Private releases. Previous initiatives improved dashboards but still lack a pragmatic workflow that (a) assigns an owner for each handoff, (b) synthesizes readiness signals, and (c) offers an inline arbitration flow with suggested mitigations.
proposal: Ship a three-part MVP: (1) Concerns feed: an automated digest that collates upstream blockers (security reviews, infra capacity, design sign-off) and ranks handoffs by risk score; (2) Conflict Resolver UI: a lightweight modal where owners can propose mitigations, adjust dates, or assign temporary guardians; (3) Escalation rules: configurable thresholds that auto-notify leads and trigger a short sync or a dedicated action item in the cross-team cadence.
success_metrics: Reduce last-minute (>2 weeks) cutover conflicts by 60% for Q2 launches
95% of cross-team handoffs have an assigned owner and readiness score 10 days before planned cutover
Time-to-resolve handoff conflicts (median) drops from 4 days to 1 day
milestones: Spec sign-off and data contract with Engineering (2026-02-28)
UX mock and usability review with Design (2026-03-18)
Internal dogfood with three teams (Eng infra, Security, Console) (2026-03-29)
acceptance_criteria: Concierge feed aggregates signals from at least: issue status, security review flag, infra capacity reservation, design sign-off field
Conflict Resolver modal allows proposing mitigation, reassigning owner, or scheduling a 15-minute escalation sync; actions persist to source tickets
Escalation rules send an actionable Slack notification to a rotation-based escalation channel and create a follow-up card in the cross-team board
Readiness score computation documented and reproducible (link to spec)
Telemetry events emitted for feed impressions, proposals created, and escalations triggered
tasks: Define minimal data contract for readiness signals with ENG backend (ENG-26112)
Design Conflict Resolver flows and edge cases (DES-4509)
Integrate escalation notifications with Slack rotation bot (ENG-26720)
Write rollout playbook and dogfood checklist for early adopters (PM-517205)
Add observability: event counts, mean time to resolve, and user feedback capture (ENG-26801)
risks_tradeoffs: Tradeoffs: keep the initial scope narrow — no heavy automations that edit other teams' schedules. Risk scoring will be heuristic at launch (rule-based) rather than ML-driven; this reduces accuracy in edge cases but speeds delivery. Need careful guardrails to avoid spamming on-call channels. Some teams may resist auto-assigned guardians — design opt-out and manual override must exist.
notes: We intentionally decouple the Concierge UI from the canonical source-of-truth tickets: actions should create clear audit trail entries that are reconciled back to source issues during rollouts.
Design requested a 'tentative reserve' flow for infra reservations to avoid overstating capacity; ENG to surface approximate delta instead of hard blockers.
Security asked for a 'must-pass' flag for P0 risk items that blocks rollout unless explicitly overridden by SOC lead (requires SSO approval flow).
